scope: One fixed positive full-support expectation per candidate shared by all scan coordinates; no root-dependent selection.

blocked_GP.weight: compact C2 Wendland (1-u)^4 (1+4u), u=abs(m-center)/5, then partition normalization
blocked_GP.minimum_signal_window_exclusion: Each positively weighted query lies inside an excluded interval at least2.25sigma(query) from its edges over39–180 MeV.
blocked_GP.boundary_behavior: Same exclusion rule; GP extrapolation near support edges, no data overwrite.

regional.objective: Poisson log likelihood, four coefficients each
regional.join: quintic smoothstep of log expected counts; C2 at endpoints
regional.turnover_context: 10MeV binned observed count maximum is60–70MeV; no local roots used.

normalization: No postfit rescaling; native predicted expected-count total recorded. In particular blocked GP does not leak excluded counts through a total-count normalization.
controls: Full-data GP candidates are self-fit controls and may absorb actual signal; blocked stitching reduces but does not eliminate source dependence.
archived_stress_qualification: Conditional hybrid stress histogram; broad component retains failed source-fit flag
